## Bug fix PR

Bugs must be reported as GitHub issues first. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../docs/CONTRIBUTING.md#bug-fixes).

### Linked issue (required)

<!-- Use a closing keyword, e.g. "Fixes #123". The issue must be confirmed by a maintainer. -->

Fixes #

### Root cause

<!-- Explain the cause of the bug in your own words. -->

### Fix summary

<!-- What did you change and why? -->

### AI assistance disclosure

<!-- State which tools, if any, were used and which parts of the PR they produced. -->

### Checklist

- [ ] A GitHub issue exists, is linked above, and was confirmed by a maintainer
- [ ] A regression test fails without the fix and passes with it
- [ ] Root cause is documented in the test's doc comment
- [ ] `cargo test` passes locally
- [ ] The PR addresses only this issue
- [ ] I can explain and defend every change in this PR
